about: Prices of the spec §6.4 candidate models, USD per million tokens, copied from the providers' official pages on verified_on (spec §16 V1). Used by `ofa eval-compare` (which model is cheaper) and the cost estimates of `ofa classify --dry-run` (standard prices; for DeepSeek the peak price) and `ofa classify --batch --dry-run` (Batch prices). Re-check the pages and update this file (and spec §16) when a provider changes prices.

notes: Prompts up to 100,000 tokens (every request here is far below); over 100,000 tokens: input 0.50, 5-minute cache write 0.625, 1-hour cache write 1, cache read 0.05, output 2.50 (batch input 0.25, output 1.25).
cache_write is the 5-minute cache write (1.25x input; the 1-hour write is 0.20); cache_read is a cache hit (0.1x input).

Batch API: 50% off input and output; the cache multipliers stack with the Batch discount (pricing page: 'These multipliers stack with other pricing modifiers, including the Batch API discount'), so the batch cache rates are half the standard ones.
inference_geo 'us' would cost 1.1x; the default global routing is priced as above.
OpenAI caches prompt prefixes automatically and does not charge cache writes; cache_read is the 'cached input' price.
Batch tier from the pricing page's Batch table (50% of Standard, as the Batch guide states).
Output includes the reasoning tokens (GPT-5 mini is a reasoning model).

deepseek-flash.peak_hours: 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday, except Chinese public holidays
notes: standard is the PEAK price; off_peak (all other hours, weekends and Chinese public holidays) is half. Comparisons and estimates use the peak price because our timers do not keep to off-peak hours.
Model version DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 on 2026-10-25; the id deepseek-flash has no pinned snapshot and moves to each new version.
DeepSeek caches prompt prefixes automatically (best effort) and does not charge cache writes; cache_read is the 'input (cache hit)' price, input the 'input (cache miss)' price.
No Batch API (not in the official docs on 2026-10-25).
Output includes reasoning tokens when thinking is on (off in classify.deepseek_model).
